desc: Ideation: contribution decomposition, lattice-point counting formula, tie-breaking rule, min-via-negation trick
Write the complete `Solution.minMaxSubarraySum` implementation (f(t), sum_of_maxes with single monotonic-stack pass computing L and R, negation trick)
Validate on the given examples (hand-traced: max-sum 11 + min-sum 9 = 20 for Example 1; Example 2 gives −6) and confirm tie-break/edge behavior (k=1 ⇒ count 1 per index; k≥n ⇒ count a·b)
Edge cases reviewed: n=1, k=1, k=n, all-equal arrays (strict-left/non-strict-right avoids double counting), all-negative arrays; algorithm is O(n) time/space so n=80000 is well within limits
